stem.text: During isolation of the cystic artery, minor bleeding occurs. Which instrument should be used first to secure hemostasis?

feedback.text: The grasper may temporarily compress but does not definitively secure the vessel.
It achieves hemostasis by delivering thermal energy (coagulation mode) to coagulate small vessels. It is effective for, but not limited to, the liver bed.
Correct. The clip applier provides definitive hemostasis.
Scissors divide tissue but cannot secure bleeding vessels.
